levels.name: Pixel-precise alignment, counting and tiny text
levels.why: Where vision models classically break: holding a row across 5 columns, counting small glyphs exactly, and reading 11px text.

levels.name: Cross-screenshot diagnosis and exhaustive scanning
levels.why: Two screenshots that only mean something together, and a scan that must not miss or invent a row.

levels.name: Reason and compute from the screen
levels.why: The live-copilot case: the answer is not written anywhere on screen. Requires reading small text or chart geometry AND doing the work.

levels.name: Precise dense extraction
levels.why: Values are on screen, but small, numerous and easy to confuse with a neighbouring cell or row.

levels.name: UI state judgement
levels.why: Not text extraction: which control is active, and whether the user is signed in. The failure mode seen in the earlier fallback test.

levels.name: Plain extraction
levels.why: Large, unambiguous text near the top of the screen.

levels.name: Gist
levels.why: Sanity floor: what am I looking at.
